messages.author: 0f36a4d38f68e366
messages.subject: Re: How to describe "maxQuantileforCensored" process?
parts:
Hi Juan,

maxQuantileforCensored is used for missing value imputation and it is the maximum quantile for deciding censored missing values. If you set it as NULL, no values will be censored. 

Best,
Ting
